**Finding submitted: deviation (§ 2.1, p0012).**

- **Issue:** § 2.1 imposes a three-year, USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay on us with no reduction or termination right — squarely in walk-away territory under MINCOMMIT, and well short of the fallback (single 12-month term, reducible on 30 days' notice, true-up not penalty).
- **Internal inconsistency noted:** § 12.3 has Vendor acknowledge we made no minimum-volume commitment, and § 7.1 limits us to Fees stated in Order Forms.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** replaces the commitment with payment for Services actually ordered or used, while preserving fallback parameters for any Order Form volume commitment.
